items.title: George Blanchin Interview, 1959-11-13
items.q: one of the most sought-after bands in that part of the country was the Claven Williams Band, from Donisonville

ctx.x: Let me see now. Who else did you mention that you heard over there in those days?

Well, in those days, I'll tell you, one of the most sought-after bands in that part of the country was the Claven Williams Band, from Donisonville. I wish I could tell you more about it, but I can't, other than that it was very much in demand. And as I recall it, they had a rather large band. I think they used eight or ten pieces.
Would they be of the school of Pierron or more like Buddy Petit?
